name: ReferralCandy
description: ReferralCandy is an ecommerce referral and affiliate platform for advocates, referred purchases, campaign incentives, rewards, tracking, and partner commissions.
agentUseSummary: ReferralCandy cannot yet be connected through Relay. Its account API uses a static Access ID and Secret Key to create MD5-signed requests without granular permission scopes, and the same contract reads customer referral data and performs purchase and reward mutations; representative credential and lifecycle acceptance is required first.

credentialRequirements.name: REFERRALCANDY_ACCESS_ID
credentialRequirements.label: ReferralCandy API Access ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Customer account API Access ID from ReferralCandy Account Profile.

credentialRequirements.name: REFERRALCANDY_SECRET_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: ReferralCandy API Secret Key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Static request-signing secret stored only in Railway's encrypted credential boundary.

blocked.label: Collect ReferralCandy credentials
blocked.description: Relay does not collect static account signing credentials before representative ownership and lifecycle acceptance.

blocked.label: Read referrals and customers
blocked.description: Referred purchases, referrer relationships, customer emails, campaign IDs, and reward data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Send purchases or update rewards
blocked.description: Purchase ingestion, returned-purchase changes, custom reward delivery, and any campaign-affecting operation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw ReferralCandy APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary methods, date-range extraction, unbounded polling, raw signatures, raw errors, and raw responses are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No ReferralCandy action is enabled before representative customer credential and authority acceptance.

runtimeSupport.description: No ReferralCandy wrappers are mounted until a representative account establishes the frozen signing contract.
No ReferralCandy wrappers are mounted until a representative account establishes the frozen signing contract.

providerSetup.blocker: ReferralCandy requires each customer to retrieve a static Access ID and Secret Key from its account profile. Every request includes the Access ID, current UNIX timestamp, and an MD5 signature derived from the unscoped Secret Key; the same contract exposes customer emails and referred purchases and accepts purchase, return, and reward mutations, while public documentation does not establish key rotation or granular authority.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should obtain authorization from a representative paying merchant, provision dedicated account credentials without exposing them in reports, store them in Railway, and return exact-account binding, rotation and revocation, timestamp tolerance and replay behavior, schema, quota, privacy-redaction, denial, and disconnect evidence before connector implementation.

evidence.supports: ReferralCandy documents v2.2 requests carrying the current UNIX timestamp, account Access ID, and an MD5 signature derived from a static API Secret Key, plus referral and referrer reads containing customer emails and purchase data and reward and purchase mutations.
ReferralCandy instructs merchants to retrieve their API Access ID/App ID and API Secret ID/Secret Key from the dashboard's Account Profile API Tokens section.
ReferralCandy describes API integration as a store connection that sends purchase and referral data and requires checkout tracking, distinct from a read-only reporting integration.
